findings.summary: Transition-aware verification checkpoints now support distinct historical verified tasks while rejecting stale, non-ancestor, or mutable evidence lineage.
Human approval ledgers now bind named actors per grant or revocation and remain append-only with exact feature, release, artifact, expiry, and evidence scope.
Exact semantic baselines prevent removal or weakening of required security decisions, features, gates, tasks, and feature task links.

summary: Independent security and privacy re-review passes the exact canonical TL-R0-001 bytes. Focused lineage, governance, evidence, network, approval, resource, secret-sanitization, and private-path controls pass; all 17 human decisions remain pending and no approval is asserted.
